name: Sayı Tahmin: ikili aramayla sayı bulunur

planSteps.description: Repeatedly guess using binary search starting at 50: if the message says the number is too small guess higher, if too big guess lower, until the message starts with 'Tebrikler!' (max 8 guesses)
The element with id 'mesaj' starts with 'Tebrikler!' and contains 'denemede buldun.'
The element with id 'rekor' shows text starting with 'En iyi skorun:'
